rows.prediction:
The image shows a diagram titled "The Writing Process." It outlines the steps involved in the writing process, which are as follows:

1. Prewriting
   - Begin with a thought web or word list and decide on a purpose, audience, format, and tone.
   - Write out the details with concern for the ideas; you will make improvements later.

2. Revise
   - Revise your first draft with a partner, paying attention to vocabulary, content and organization.
   - Rewrite your draft including the changes identified in the revision stage.

3. Proofread
   - Proofread your second draft, correcting spelling, grammar, punctuation, and mechanical errors.
   - Publish the completed story.

rows.question: Write a short story about a student writing an essay (the title is "The Impact of Technology on Society.") and their experiences going through each of the stages shown in the image.
rows.prediction:
Once upon a time, there was a student named Alex who was tasked with writing an essay on the impact of technology on society. He was excited about the topic and eager to get started.

Alex began by brainstorming ideas and creating a thought web. He wrote down all the thoughts that came to mind, connecting them to see how they related to his main idea. He decided that he wanted to focus on the positive and negative aspects of technology, so he wrote down the details with concern for the ideas.

As he worked on his first draft, Alex realized that he needed to revise it. He asked a friend to read it and give him feedback. His friend pointed out some areas where he could improve the content and organization of his essay. Alex revised his draft, incorporating the changes and making sure that his ideas were clearly conveyed.

After his essay was revised, Alex proofread it. He checked for spelling and grammar mistakes, making sure that his essay was polished and ready for publication. Finally, he published his completed story, sharing his thoughts on the impact of technology with the world.

Throughout the process, Alex learned the importance of each stage of the writing process. He realized that going back and forth from step to step was essential to creating a well-written and polished essay. He was proud of his final product and the effort he put into each stage of the process.
